alert_episode_intakes_root_state.name: alert_episode_intakes_root_state
alert_episode_intakes_root_state.value: (state in ('pending', 'posting', 'rejected', 'uncertain') and root_message_id is null) or (state in ('posted', 'accepted') and root_message_id is not null)

alert_episode_intakes_acceptance.name: alert_episode_intakes_acceptance
alert_episode_intakes_acceptance.value: state <> 'accepted' or (incident_id is not null and binding_id is not null)

assessment_grades_has_a_verdict.name: assessment_grades_has_a_verdict
assessment_grades_has_a_verdict.value: "assessment_grades"."model_verdict" is not null or "assessment_grades"."human_verdict" is not null

directory_accounts_provider_external_id_.name: directory_accounts_provider_external_id_current_idx
directory_accounts_provider_external_id_.where: "directory_accounts"."deleted_at" is null and "directory_accounts"."external_id" is not null

identity_providers_scim_credential_check.name: identity_providers_scim_credential_check
identity_providers_scim_credential_check.value: "identity_providers"."scim_enabled" = ("identity_providers"."scim_token_hash" is not null and "identity_providers"."scim_token_created_at" is not null and "identity_providers"."scim_token_expires_at" is not null)

identity_providers_scim_eligibility_chec.name: identity_providers_scim_eligibility_check
identity_providers_scim_eligibility_chec.value: not "identity_providers"."scim_enabled" or ("identity_providers"."kind" = 'oidc' and "identity_providers"."browser_client_id" is not null)

notifications_recipient_check.name: notifications_recipient_check
notifications_recipient_check.value: "notifications"."recipient_user_id" is not null or "notifications"."recipient_email" is not null

deployments_provider_event_uq.name: deployments_provider_event_uq
deployments_provider_event_uq.where: "deployments"."connector_id" is not null and "deployments"."provider_id" is not null and "deployments"."source" <> 'argocd'

deployments_argocd_provider_event_uq.name: deployments_argocd_provider_event_uq
deployments_argocd_provider_event_uq.where: "deployments"."connector_id" is not null and "deployments"."provider_id" is not null and "deployments"."source" = 'argocd'

deployments_legacy_sha_uq.name: deployments_legacy_sha_uq
deployments_legacy_sha_uq.where: "deployments"."connector_id" is not null and "deployments"."provider_id" is null

deployments_unscoped_provider_event_uq.name: deployments_unscoped_provider_event_uq
deployments_unscoped_provider_event_uq.where: "deployments"."connector_id" is null and "deployments"."provider_id" is not null and "deployments"."source" <> 'argocd'

deployments_unscoped_argocd_provider_eve.name: deployments_unscoped_argocd_provider_event_uq
deployments_unscoped_argocd_provider_eve.where: "deployments"."connector_id" is null and "deployments"."provider_id" is not null and "deployments"."source" = 'argocd'

github_repositories_active_name_uq.name: github_repositories_active_name_uq
github_repositories_active_name_uq.where: "github_repositories"."connector_id" is not null and "github_repositories"."removed_at" is null

gitlab_projects_active_path_uq.name: gitlab_projects_active_path_uq
gitlab_projects_active_path_uq.where: "gitlab_projects"."connector_id" is not null and "gitlab_projects"."removed_at" is null

incident_feedback_target_decision_vocabu.name: incident_feedback_target_decision_vocabulary
incident_feedback_target_decision_vocabu.value:
(
        ("incident_feedback"."target_type" = 'finding' and "incident_feedback"."decision" in ('confirm', 'correct'))
        or ("incident_feedback"."target_type" = 'entity' and "incident_feedback"."decision" in ('confirm', 'correct'))
        or ("incident_feedback"."target_type" = 'correlation' and "incident_feedback"."decision" in ('group', 'separate'))
        or ("incident_feedback"."target_type" = 'noise' and "incident_feedback"."decision" in ('noise', 'not_noise'))
      )

incident_relations_correlation_feedback_.name: incident_relations_correlation_feedback_idx
incident_relations_correlation_feedback_.where: "incident_relations"."correlation_feedback" is not null and "incident_relations"."superseded_at" is null

incident_relations_correlation_feedback_.name: incident_relations_correlation_feedback_shape
incident_relations_correlation_feedback_.value:
"incident_relations"."correlation_feedback" is null or coalesce((
        "incident_relations"."decided_by" = 'human'
        and "incident_relations"."decided_by_user_id" is not null
        and jsonb_typeof("incident_relations"."correlation_feedback") = 'object'
        and "incident_relations"."correlation_feedback"->>'decision' in ('group', 'separate')
        and jsonb_typeof("incident_relations"."correlation_feedback"->'sourceScopeKeys') = 'array'
        and jsonb_typeof("incident_relations"."correlation_feedback"->'targetScopeKeys') = 'array'
        and jsonb_typeof("incident_relations"."correlation_feedback"->'sharedScopeKeys') = 'array'
        and not jsonb_path_exists("incident_relations"."correlation_feedback", '$.sourceScopeKeys[*] ? (@.type() != "string")')
        and not jsonb_path_exists("incident_relations"."correlation_feedback", '$.targetScopeKeys[*] ? (@.type() != "string")')
        and not jsonb_path_exists("incident_relations"."correlation_feedback", '$.sharedScopeKeys[*] ? (@.type() != "string")')
      ), false)

incident_relations_agent_causal_evidence.name: incident_relations_agent_causal_evidence
incident_relations_agent_causal_evidence.value: "incident_relations"."type" <> 'caused_by' or "incident_relations"."decided_by" <> 'agent' or ("incident_relations"."decision_run_id" is not null and "incident_relations"."confidence" is not null and cardinality("incident_relations"."evidence_ids") > 0)

incident_signals_provider_episode_uq.name: incident_signals_provider_episode_uq
incident_signals_provider_episode_uq.where: "incident_signals"."data_source_id" is not null and "incident_signals"."provider_fingerprint" is not null and "incident_signals"."starts_at" is not null

incident_signals_correlation_scope_idx.name: incident_signals_correlation_scope_idx
incident_signals_correlation_scope_idx.where: "incident_signals"."data_source_id" is not null and "incident_signals"."monitor_key" is not null

incident_signals_correlation_history_idx.name: incident_signals_correlation_history_idx
incident_signals_correlation_history_idx.where: "incident_signals"."data_source_id" is not null and "incident_signals"."monitor_key" is not null

incident_signals_surface_monitor_active_.name: incident_signals_surface_monitor_active_idx
incident_signals_surface_monitor_active_.where: "incident_signals"."data_source_id" is null and "incident_signals"."monitor_key" is not null

incident_signals_correlation_decision_sh.name: incident_signals_correlation_decision_shape
incident_signals_correlation_decision_sh.value:
(
        (
          "incident_signals"."correlation_method" is null
          and "incident_signals"."correlation_rationale" is null
          and "incident_signals"."correlation_features" is null
          and "incident_signals"."correlation_confidence" is null
          and "incident_signals"."correlation_window_started_at" is null
          and "incident_signals"."correlation_window_expires_at" is null
          and "incident_signals"."correlation_max_age_at" is null
        )
        or coalesce((
          "incident_signals"."correlation_method" is not null
          and "incident_signals"."correlation_rationale" is not null
          and btrim("incident_signals"."correlation_rationale") <> ''
          and "incident_signals"."correlation_features" is not null
          and jsonb_typeof("incident_signals"."correlation_features") = 'array'
          and not jsonb_path_exists("incident_signals"."correlation_features", '$[*] ? (@.type() != "string")')
          and "incident_signals"."correlation_confidence" is not null
          and "incident_signals"."correlation_window_started_at" is not null
          and "incident_signals"."correlation_window_expires_at" is not null
          and "incident_signals"."correlation_max_age_at" is not null
          and "incident_signals"."correlation_window_expires_at" >= "incident_signals"."correlation_window_started_at"
          and "incident_signals"."correlation_max_age_at" >= "incident_signals"."correlation_window_started_at"
        ), false)
      )

investigation_runs_completion_shape.name: investigation_runs_completion_shape
investigation_runs_completion_shape.value: (("investigation_runs"."outcome" is null and "investigation_runs"."result" is null and "investigation_runs"."completed_at" is null) or ("investigation_runs"."outcome" is not null and "investigation_runs"."result" is not null and "investigation_runs"."completed_at" is not null))

jobs_classify_idempotency_uq.name: jobs_classify_idempotency_uq
jobs_classify_idempotency_uq.where: type = 'classify' AND idempotency_key IS NOT NULL

jobs_classify_event_uq.name: jobs_classify_event_uq
jobs_classify_event_uq.where: type = 'classify' AND event_key IS NOT NULL

jobs_founding_live_uq.name: jobs_founding_live_uq
jobs_founding_live_uq.where: type = 'founding.provision' AND status IN ('queued', 'processing') AND idempotency_key IS NOT NULL

llm_invocations_configured_cost_nonnegat.name: llm_invocations_configured_cost_nonnegative_finite
llm_invocations_configured_cost_nonnegat.value: "llm_invocations"."configured_cost_usd" is null or ("llm_invocations"."request_count" > 0 and "llm_invocations"."input_tokens" + "llm_invocations"."output_tokens" + "llm_invocations"."cache_read_tokens" + "llm_invocations"."cache_write_tokens" > 0 and "llm_invocations"."configured_cost_usd" >= 0 and "llm_invocations"."configured_cost_usd" < 'Infinity'::numeric)

postmortems_publish_shape.name: postmortems_publish_shape
postmortems_publish_shape.value: ("postmortems"."status" = 'published') = ("postmortems"."published_at" is not null and "postmortems"."published_by_user_id" is not null)

signal_disposition_evaluations_active_jo.name: signal_disposition_evaluations_active_job
signal_disposition_evaluations_active_jo.value: status not in ('queued', 'running') or job_id is not null

signal_disposition_evaluations_result_sh.name: signal_disposition_evaluations_result_shape
signal_disposition_evaluations_result_sh.value:
(
        status <> 'completed'
        or (
          total is not null and total > 0
          and correct is not null and correct between 0 and total
          and critical_safety_misses is not null and critical_safety_misses >= 0
          and class_metrics is not null
          and scenario_results is not null
          and completed_at is not null
        )
      )

signal_disposition_evaluations_failure_s.name: signal_disposition_evaluations_failure_shape
signal_disposition_evaluations_failure_s.value: status <> 'failed' or (failure_category is not null and completed_at is not null)

signal_dispositions_effective_vocabulary.name: signal_dispositions_effective_vocabulary
signal_dispositions_effective_vocabulary.value: effective_disposition is null or effective_disposition in ('investigate', 'ticket', 'log')

signal_dispositions_ticket_shape.name: signal_dispositions_ticket_shape
signal_dispositions_ticket_shape.value:
(
        disposition <> 'ticket'
        or (
          action is not null
          and safe_deferral_reason is not null
          and risk_if_ignored is not null
          and review_horizon_minutes between 1 and 10080
        )
      )

signal_dispositions_promotion_shape.name: signal_dispositions_promotion_shape
signal_dispositions_promotion_shape.value:
(
        promoted_at is null
        or (
          disposition = 'ticket'
          and incident_id is not null
          and promoted_by_surface is not null
          and promoted_by_actor is not null
          and promotion_criterion is not null
          and promotion_reason is not null
        )
      )

tenant_signal_policies_unsolved.name: tenant_signal_policies_unsolved
tenant_signal_policies_unsolved.value: unsolved_after_minutes is null or unsolved_after_minutes between 1 and 10080

tenant_signal_policies_enforcement.name: tenant_signal_policies_enforcement
tenant_signal_policies_enforcement.value:
classification_mode <> 'enforce' or (
        enforcement_approved_at is not null
        and enforcement_approved_by_user_id is not null
        and approved_evaluation_id is not null
        and approved_corpus_version is not null
        and approved_contract_version is not null
        and approved_runtime_fingerprint is not null
      )
